import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert text-encoded numbers to numeric
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (set impossible value to NaN; row kept for counting)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Count penguins per island using unique ids (id is unique)
    counts = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    # Drop any missing island keys
    counts = counts.dropna()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
